tiers.question: Why, and what will we bet on?
What do we commit to, and when?
What do people and the system do?
What does the business run on, by what rules?
What ships, and in what order?
How do we know, and who decided?

contested_in.note: the claim that contradicts it; mirrors attested_in; the claim names the row in contradicts_rows

value_defs.later: Named under a capability, with a bet; not drafted.
value_defs.now: Being built: specs with acceptance criteria.

proposed_in.note: a lab-study id or a source slug: where this row was first put forward

revises.note: the id of the row of the same kind this revised proposal replaces; no edge

value_defs.agreed: Recorded as agreed, or settled by a decision on a kind with the aligned trait.
value_defs.draft: One or more claims cite it.
value_defs.locked: Recorded as locked, or status permanent.
value_defs.seed: Nothing cited yet: the default when no claim supports the row.
value_defs.shaped: Two or more claims, at least one with a human origin, or recorded as shaped.

value_defs.guided: Follow the intent; vary the form.
